Lessons.Title: More Perimeter Problems
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will solve geometric problems using your understanding of length measurements, unit conversion, multiplicative comparison, and addition or subtraction of fractions.
In a previous lesson, you were reminded about the relationship between the side lengths and the perimeter of a rectangle and reasoned multiplicatively to solve problems about those measurements. In this lesson, you continue to do so but in contexts that require them to convert the units and interpret them.
Core relationship: Find missing dimensions from perimeter. Solve 2 × (length + width) = perimeter with consistent units.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  True or False: Fractions and Whole Numbers	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Along the Walls in Tiny Steps	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  Missing Measurements	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  A Rectangle and a Trapezoid	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: A rectangle has perimeter 30 cm and one side 5 cm. Find the other side.
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): A rectangle has perimeter 42 cm and length 12 cm. Find width.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
